findings.title: Apply the untrusted-field restriction to website_name
findings.body: The new website_name attribute is not included in untrusted_attributes, so it is serialized even when scope.restrict_user_fields?(object) suppresses website for a TL0 user viewed anonymously. This exposes the restricted website host (and, for matching domains, its path), and the updated template displays it despite the website field being hidden. Give website_name the same restriction as website and test with a populated TL0 website.
